text:
ops-bot: @here Quick availability + policy note for AMD MI300X Dedicated pools: rolling launches in ap-southeast-sg (Singapore) and eu-west-rt (Rotterdam). Read below for capacity, constraints, and action items.
rachel_prod: TL;DR: this is a controlled availability window for customers and partners. Not a broad GA. Sign-ups via the MI300X access form: https://redwood.example.com/mi300x-access. Include model families, expected concurrency, and whether you need long-context (<64k) support.
vikas_infra: Deployment details: pool names mi300x-sg-limited and mi300x-rt-limited. Initial inventory: Singapore: 12 GPUs (3 nodes); Rotterdam: 20 GPUs (5 nodes). These pools are non-preemptible for the window; HSM/KMS will be enabled in Rotterdam, SG will follow within 48h. Default session cap: 12h. Note: SSD-backed local cache enabled; do not exceed 2GB/session persistent cache without approval.
dena_eng: Engineering note: MI300X shows strong throughput on int8 quantized workloads but needs tuning for long sequence KV-cache allocation. We recommend teams run the nightly mi300x-ci job which auto-runs perf suites. Link: https://ci.redwood.example.com/mi300x. Example reserve command for internal smoke tests:
```
redwood reserve --pool mi300x-rt-limited --count 1 --duration 6h --team=llm-research --note "mi300x smoke"
```
jen_sre: Reliability summary: so far one Rotterdam node exhibited an intermittent PCIe error during stress runs; infra drained and vendor is shipping a replacement board. We added an early-warning rule for PCIe errors >1/min and a thermal page at temp>=83C. We also added a per-node PCIe health metric to the MI300 topology dashboard.
oliver_security: Security: Rotterdam HSM enabled. Singapore provisional: HSM pending; do not run regulated datasets in SG until HSM confirmed. All pools log key operations; retention is standard preview retention (30 days). If you require export controls clearance for models/datasets, open a ticket with security and legal.
kira_sales: GTM guidance: this is an "early access window" for partners. Do not promise GA or unlimited capacity. Current invited partners include SynapseAI and NovaSearch; if you have inbound interest route them to me. Pricing: we'll provide partner pricing for the window; retail pricing will be announced at GA.
vikas_infra: Admin notes: weve disabled burst capacity for these pools during the limited window to stabilize noisy-neighbor behavior. If teams need extended sessions or higher per-tenant GPU caps, apply for "mi300x-trusted" list via the access form. We support per-tenant overrides via infra-admin with CLI example:
```
redwood infra override-session --tenant=synapse --pool=mi300x-rt-limited --duration=36h --reason="partner eval"
```
dena_eng: Perf snapshot (internal runs): Rotterdam 32k context p50 190ms/token, p95 540ms/token; Singapore 32k context p50 210ms/token, p95 620ms/token. Note: long-context runs see higher variance on mixed-precision models; use KV-cache tuning doc in the access form.
jen_sre: Action items: - SRE: add PCIe replacement checklist and alert flow into runbook (ETA: 48h) - Infra: enable SG HSM or label SG as non-compliant (ETA: 48h) - Eng: post mi300x perf spreadsheet and CI links to #eng-runtime (ETA: EOD) - GTM: consolidate partner invite list and messaging (ETA: Tue COB)
oliver_security: Reminder: do not run PII or regulated workloads on SG until HSM is confirmed. If anyone needs an exception, file a request with a data handling plan.
ops-bot: :white_check_mark: Epic created: mi300x-limited-window. If you find anomalies, tag bugs with [mi300x] and ping owners. Thanks team!
